interpretation: This bridge is a bounded restart-continuity gate. A PASS is required before a new Swiss national qualification, but does not itself authorize month or 100 m production. Diagnostic exceptions are non-fatal only when every hash-bound quantitative bound passes; structural, prognostic, conservation, and finite-value failures remain fatal.
